def: Google's on-device inference runtime, formerly TensorFlow Lite, which runs models converted from PyTorch, JAX or TensorFlow on CPU, GPU and NPU across mobile, web, desktop and IoT.
practice: Models ship as .tflite FlatBuffer files; for on-device LLMs Google points to the separate LiteRT-LM library, and NPU support covers vendors such as Qualcomm and MediaTek.
